description: Multi-SWE-bench style (Java): a three-item bug report against a small multi-class booking library, each cause in a different class - an inclusive range boundary in TimeSlot.overlaps, reference equality on String ids in RoomCalendar.remove, and a missing null guard in BookingService.book. A plain-Java test runner compiled by run_tests.py with javac is the acceptance bar, including a guard that real overlaps still conflict.
